exact_unresolved_mapping: No matched-boundary-condition per-fastener lateral force-slip calibration maps the FE distributed wood/steel foundation plus shaft-bending and clearance law to an NDS-equivalent gamma for the same D, shear plane, materials, row direction, and interface fit.
The current wood and plate foundation coefficients are declared scenario values; no measured or code-supported derivation ties either coefficient to 180000D^1.5 or 270000D^1.5.
For top wood/steel, no validated effective axial EA of the formed two-leg angle is extracted from its condensed port matrix for an NDS row direction.

NDS row alignment and main/side gross or §11.3.6.3 equivalent areas must be established from actual signed load direction. A geometry-only diagonal pair and complete per-bolt wrenches/couples do not themselves satisfy the row assumptions.
group_slip_method_assessment.scope: The unchanged FE bearing law has positive radial gaps and direction/state-dependent post-engagement tangent. Its distributed foundation and nominal shaft stiffness are not calibrated to NDS gamma. NDS Cg adjusts applicable resistance; it is not a bolt-force allocation or an automatic replacement for 1/n.

physical_row_group_criteria.reuse_scope: Existing six equation controls and identical helper reused; three current input hashes and five saved scenario values verified. No global solve, geometry change, load reduction or factor adoption.

primary_row_method_disposition.exact_remaining_method: A defensible mapping from the actual nonuniform, nonparallel per-bolt shear-plane forces and free couples to compatible multi-fastener wood/steel/shaft resistance, including axial transfer and local splitting, with applicable row and edge/end geometry. The existing prescribed force-only modes and uncalibrated FE slip law do not supply that mapping.

two_bolt_across_grain_subset.scope: Conditional endpoint geometry only; within-row spacing, edge/end, moments and full group behavior remain separate. Current four-bolt forces cannot be transferred to a two-bolt subset.

exact_remaining_inputs_and_method: Applicable product-specific or test-derived bending yield strength and actual delivered body/root/grip geometry.
A defensible complete group and full-wrench interaction, including axial transfer and local splitting; force-only TR12 modes do not bound a pure couple.
rear_full_wrench_reference.interpretation: All 24 constructed lateral bearing fields meet their declared reference. Eight bending and ten extra von Mises comparisons exceed the generic 45 ksi/divisor-5 references. These are sufficient constructed material bounds, not adopted NDS whole-wrench resistance or demonstrated physical failures. The extra von Mises/divisor-5 check is separate from the retained direct elastic steel family. No favorable product Fyb or tensile-yield substitution was made.
rear_full_wrench_reference.method: Reused two-cell equilibrium construction preserves each receiver transverse force and first moment; saved axial head/nut captures, torsion and shaft gravity retained once. Current body/root transition and conditional section floors are used.
rear_full_wrench_reference.scope_limit: This exactly equilibrated constructed pressure field closes each receiver's 3D force/free-couple wrench against saved shaft gravity and end captures. NDS/TR12 six-mode equations remain force-only and do not supply a formal nonzero-couple, axial, or torsional interaction. Bearing and steel thresholds are conditional material-reference comparisons; failure of a sufficient bound is not physical failure.
